title: Nvidia's model GR00T 2 watches humans on video, then imagines itself as the robot
original_title: Nvidia's model GR00T 2 watches humans on video, then imagines itself as the robot
summary: Nvidia's new AI model GR00T 2 is designed to teach robots new tasks without laborious teleoperation. Instead, the system transfers human hand movements from videos to robotic arms, trained on about 4…
title_zh: 英伟达 GR00T 2 用人类视频教机器人
lead_zh: The Decoder 报道，GR00T 2 试图把视频中的人手动作迁到机械臂上，以减少遥操作采集。训练素材约 40 万小时，但不同任务的成功率仍在 10% 到 80% 之间。
